name: Shelburne Farms Summer Camps
description_short: Summer camps for ages 5–17 on Shelburne Farms, a 1,400-acre working farm and education nonprofit in Shelburne, Vermont. Campers take part in the daily routines of the farm and explore the natural world, with programs set up by age group.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: This is a general Family & Youth Programs overview page, not the camp's detail page. It covers several programs (family programs, preschool Adventures, 4-H, Work and Learn, afterschool) and only briefly describes summer camps.
The only camp season mentioned is 2026 ('2026 Camp Information'), and that summer is already over as of 2026-10-13. Nothing about 2027 camps is posted yet.
The ages 5–17 cover all camps combined. Each camp likely has a narrower age range.
unknowns: Camp type (day or overnight). The page doesn't say, though it is probably a day camp
